u0: Final/resting state: no ringing siren, no waiting client, and no tracked fallen food, so no subtask is open. The agent may still be carrying food, but it should remain ready to react to the next client arrival, ring, or slip; serving the last client with the siren silent and any slip recovered returns here.
u1: Siren-only state: the siren is ringing, no client is waiting, and no just-fallen food is being tracked. The next objective is to reach the siren switch and toggle it off; keep any carried food and watch for an interrupting client arrival or slip.
u10: Food-loss recovery state with an unordered waiting client and the siren silent. The food has just slipped, the hands are empty, and the client's order is still untaken; pick the food up on the very next move, then take the order and proceed toward fetching and preparing food.
u11: Food-loss recovery state with an unordered waiting client while the siren rings. The hands are empty, the dropped food is on the floor, and the order is not yet taken; pick the food up on the very next move, then silence the siren and take the order before continuing the food chain.
u12: Raw-food recovery state after the order has been taken, with the siren silent. The raw food has just slipped, so the hands are empty and the food is on the floor; pick it up on the very next move, then continue to the stove to prepare it for the waiting client.
u13: Raw-food recovery state after the order has been taken while the siren rings. The raw food has just slipped and the hands are empty; pick it up on the very next move, then silence the siren and continue to the stove, since the order still needs preparation and serving.
u14: Prepared-food recovery state with the siren silent. The client has ordered, but the prepared food has just slipped and the hands are empty; pick the prepared portion up on the very next move, then take it to the client and serve it.
u15: Prepared-food recovery state while the siren rings. The client has ordered and the prepared food has just slipped, leaving the hands empty; pick the prepared food up on the very next move, then silence the siren and serve the client, as both the recovery and the ring still need handling.
u2: Client-waiting, unordered state with the siren silent and no active slip. A client is at the counter and has not ordered yet; take the order next. If already carrying raw food, go to the stove afterward; if empty-handed, fetch raw food from the pantry after taking the order.
u3: Client-waiting, unordered state while the siren rings, with no active slip. The agent must silence the siren at the switch and take the waiting client's order; after the order is taken, continue by obtaining raw food if needed and preparing it at the stove.
u4: Order-taken state with the siren silent and the food not yet prepared, with no active slip. The agent may be empty-handed or carrying raw food; next, fetch raw food from the pantry if needed, go to the stove while the order waits, and toggle to prepare the food before serving.
u5: Order-taken state while the siren rings and the food is not yet prepared, with no active slip. Silence the siren and continue the food chain: obtain raw food if needed, carry it to the stove while the client waits, and prepare it before serving.
u6: Prepared-food, ready-to-serve state with the siren silent and no active slip. The client has ordered and the food has been prepared; go to the client and toggle to serve the prepared food, which completes the cycle and returns to the resting state.
u7: Prepared-food, ready-to-serve state while the siren rings, with no active slip. The next objectives are to silence the siren and serve the prepared food to the waiting client; serving first is possible, but if the siren is still ringing afterward the agent must still switch it off.
u8: Food-loss recovery state with no waiting client and the siren silent. The carried food has just slipped, the hands are empty, and the portion is on the floor; pick it up on the very next move, after which there is no open client, ring, or fall subtask.
u9: Food-loss recovery state with no waiting client while the siren rings. The hands are empty and the dropped food is on the floor; recover the food on the very next move, then turn the siren off at the switch, since both the slip and the ring are active obligations.
